about.title: Professional Movers in Semarang
about.body: Indo Mover provides moving services for homes, offices, warehouses, and apartments in Semarang and the surrounding area. We focus on the safety of your belongings, on-time delivery, and customer satisfaction—from survey and packing all the way to unloading. Our moving services have been trusted by hundreds of families and businesses across Central Java. We serve all districts in Semarang—Tembalang, Banyumanik, Pedurungan, Ngaliyan, West Semarang, and more—as well as nearby cities like Demak, Ungaran, and Kendal.

howItWorks.title: Indo Mover's Moving Process — Simple & Transparent

steps.title: Contact & Consult
steps.desc: Chat on WhatsApp or call us. Tell us about your move—origin, destination, date, and a rough idea of what needs to be moved.

steps.title: Free On-Site Survey
steps.desc: Our team visits your location to assess the volume of items, evaluate access, and recommend the right vehicle. The survey is free and non-binding.

steps.title: Quote & Confirm
steps.desc: You receive a transparent price quote based on the survey. Once confirmed, we schedule the move on the date that works for you.

steps.title: Move Done

items.q: How much does a moving service in Semarang cost?
items.a: The cost depends on the volume of items, distance, and add-ons such as packing or loading-unloading. Indo Mover offers a free on-site survey to give you an accurate quote before the move.
We serve home, office, and apartment moves across Semarang and the surrounding area, plus inter-city moves throughout Central Java and beyond.

items.q: Are belongings insured during the move?
items.a: Insurance is available as an add-on for high-value items. Details can be discussed during the survey.

items.q: How long does a typical home move take?
items.a: Usually 4–8 hours for an in-city home move in Semarang, depending on volume and access. Inter-city moves vary by route.
Yes. We have a dedicated team for office, retail, and warehouse moves with after-hours scheduling so your business isn't disrupted.

items.q: How do I book Indo Mover?
items.a: Just reach out on WhatsApp. The team will schedule a free on-site survey and give you a quote tailored to your move.

items.q: What is the estimated price range for moving in Semarang?
items.a: Moving costs in Semarang typically start from Rp 500,000 for a small in-city move using a pick-up truck, up to Rp 3,000,000–5,000,000 for a large home using a Fuso truck. The final price depends on volume, vehicle type, distance, and any add-ons. We offer a free survey for an accurate estimate.

items.q: What vehicles does Indo Mover have available?
items.a: Indo Mover has Pick-Up/Blind Van (small moves or boarding rooms), CDE/Small Box Truck (medium capacity, 2–3 rooms), CDD/Medium Box Truck (large capacity, 3–4 bedroom home), and Fuso/Wingbox (office or warehouse relocations). Our team recommends the most efficient option during the free survey.

items.q: Which districts in Semarang do you cover?
items.a: We cover all districts in Semarang, including Tembalang, Banyumanik, Pedurungan, Genuk, Central Semarang, West Semarang, North Semarang, South Semarang, East Semarang, Candisari, Gajahmungkur, Gunungpati, Mijen, Ngaliyan, and surrounding areas. We also serve nearby cities like Demak, Ungaran, Kendal, and Salatiga.

Yes, we handle inter-city relocations across Central Java and beyond. Popular routes include Semarang–Jakarta, Semarang–Surabaya, Semarang–Yogyakarta, and Semarang–Bandung. Schedules and pricing for inter-city moves are confirmed during the survey.
